reviews.title: Warning: Asks for money on the 15th day of the “Introductory” course
reviews.text:
I understand that they’re not obliged to give anything for free, but content that looks free should indeed be free. Otherwise that’s just deception. The practice of basically deciding the user is “sufficiently hooked” before they’re told they’re required to subscribe to access the rest of their program is disrespectful to the users to say the least.

I advise potential users to avoid this app and take the time to look for alternatives, which are many.

reviews.title: Soul AI Should be Removed!
reviews.text: Soul AI is a joke. It barely works, which is probably for the best. It seems to be a poorly put together AI that has no business giving anyone advice on anything, let alone people who have mental health issues and are putting their trust in you! It makes you seem like you just care about money and not mental health. If Soul AI is still a part of Meditopia when my subscription ends, I’m not going to renew.
